request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We train a cost-prediction model for the reimbursement decision; summary tables are not enough because costs are modelled per patient. Only coefficients leave the environment.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised encounters and medications of patients who had an inpatient stay with heart failure as main diagnosis in 2025.
definitions: Heart failure stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with I50 and whose start_date is in 2025.
Cohort = patients with at least one heart failure stay.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
